newsitem.title: USA: U.S. truckers win diesel surcharge from government.
newsitem.headline: U.S. truckers win diesel surcharge from government.

text.p: A mechanism for U.S. truckers to impose diesel fuel surcharges on certain U.S. government shipper clients went into effect Tuesday, though prices are not now high enough to trigger it, a truckers source said.
"We're pleased to have a surcharge mechanism in place should diesel prices again surge," said Ken Simonson, chief economist at American Trucking Associations, a trade group.

Last week's agreement allows truckers to impose a surcharge on shippers for the U.S. General Services Administration (GSA), witch manages freight services for all federal agencies other than the U.S. Department of Defense.
